ar01.text: تاني يوم ليّا في لندن. <short pause> المنبه رن الساعة سبعة… وأنا ما سمعتوش. <short pause> صحيت الساعة تمانية وعشرة.
ar01.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Sleepy at first, then alarmed.

ar02.text: جريت على المدرسة من غير فطار ولا قهوة… <short pause> وده كان الغلط الأول في اليوم.
ar02.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Rushed, with a knowing laugh at the end.

ar03.text: طول الطريق وأنا بحضّر تحية الصبح. <short pause> عارفها: جود مورنينج! <short pause> سهلة… بس أنا كنت نايم وأنا بجري.
ar03.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Out of breath, self-mocking.

ar04.text: قلتلها تصبحي على خير… <short pause> الساعة تمانية الصبح! <short pause> هي ضحكت، وأنا كنت عايز أرجع أنام من الكسوف.
ar04.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Mortified, comic.

ar05.text: أول شفطة قهوة… ورجعت بني آدم. <short pause> وخدت بالي إنها ردت بجملة مش عارفها: <short pause> يور ويلكم.
ar05.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Relieved and content, then curious.

ar06.text: قلت: ويلكم! زي ما بنقول عفوًا… <short pause> بس طلعت ناقصة كلمة. <short pause> هحكيلكم.
ar06.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Confident then sheepish, teasing.

ar07.text: وفي الآخر، قلتها صح: <short pause> جود نايت بتتقال وإنت ماشي، مش وإنت جاي. <short pause> بس الاستمارة دي… فيها سؤال وقفت قدامه.
ar07.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Satisfied, then a worried cliffhanger.

ar08.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Upbeat, like a friendly teacher.

ar09.text: الصبح، وبعد الضهر، وبالليل. <short pause> لكن جود نايت مش تحية… <short pause> دي للوداع بس، وإنت ماشي أو رايح تنام.
ar09.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Clear and explanatory, friendly teacher.

ar10.text: ولما حد يسألك: هاو آر يو؟ <short pause> ما تردش رد محفوظ. قول رد حقيقي:
ar10.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Clear, a little playful.

ar11.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Clear and explanatory.

ar12.text: ولما حد يقولك: ثانك يو، <short pause> ما تقولش: ويلكم، لوحدها. <short pause> الرد الصح:
ar12.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Clear and explanatory.

ar13.text: وكلمتين من الذوق: <short pause> بليز لما تطلب، <short pause> وسوري لما تغلط.
ar13.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Clear and warm.

ar14.text: دورك! <short pause> ميا بتسألك… رد عليها رد حقيقي، بصوت عالي.
ar14.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Energetic, encouraging.

ar15.text: رديت؟ برافو! <short pause> واكتب في الكومنتات: إنت عامل إيه النهارده… بالإنجليزي.
ar15.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Proud and warm.

ar16.text: الحلقة الجاية: الاستمارة. <short pause> أرقام، وسؤال: هاو أولد آر يو؟… <short pause> وأنا قلت: آي هاف توينتي سيكس ييرز. <short pause> وطلعت غلط.
ar16.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Teaser, mysterious and funny.
